department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry; no late applications.
deadline.quote: The deadlines to apply are December 1, 2026, for PhD applicants and January 12, 2027, for MS applicants.

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores (general or subject) are accepted.
gre_subject.quote: MSE Admissions will NOT accept GRE Scores Submitted.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and MSE will not accept GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the general or subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are not required for admission to the Materials Science and Engineering PhD or MS Programs for Fall 2027 entry.

also.quote: No, the GRE is not required. MSE Admissions will NOT accept GRE Scores Submitted.

supervisor.value: You are admitted to the department as a whole and matched with an advisor during the first year; no advisor is needed before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are not expected to have a confirmed PhD faculty advisor before applying. We admit students to the department as a whole, and their faculty advisors are matched during the first year of the program.

funding.value: All PhD students get full support (stipend/salary, tuition, health insurance subsidy) for the whole program while making satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: We provide full financial support to all of our PhD students for the duration of their program, contingent on maintaining satisfactory degree progress.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.
